# Provenance — ein-formation-http-client v0.1.0

SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

This archive is an **allowlisted extract** of the reviewed standalone public EIN
formation HTTP client. It is shipped as a static download from ein.llc so outside
agents can acquire the client over public HTTPS without access to the private
`epistemedeus/ein-llc-lean` repository.

The commit above identifies the unchanged runtime and examples. Download packaging,
README, license and package metadata were added or reviewed in the download cohort.
The public manifest records SHA-256 for every exact archived file and both archives;
its sourceTreeSha256 hashes the compact JSON sourceFiles array in allowlist order.
It is a content identity, not a signature or evidence of hosted availability.

Boundaries: zero npm runtime dependencies; agents never claim, pay, or invent grants.
Tests, private fixtures, partner-first-case materials, and activation-client packages
are intentionally excluded from this allowlist.
